description: Explore skincare families for cleansing, hydration, sun protection and recovery. Contact Soie Clinics to discuss a routine that suits your skin and treatment.
html:
Home · Products

Chosen with care

Skincare, selected
by Soie.

A home routine should be easy to follow and suit your skin. Ask our team which products to use, how to introduce them and what is currently available in the clinic.

Cleanse & Prep

Gentle Cleansers

A gentle cleanser removes daily buildup while helping your skin stay comfortable. We can help you choose one for your skin type.

Ask our team about availability

Brighten

Vitamin C & Antioxidants

Vitamin C and antioxidant serums can support a routine for dullness and uneven tone. The formula and strength should suit your skin.

Ask our team about availability

Hydrate

Hyaluronic Serums & Moisturisers

Hyaluronic acid helps skin retain moisture, while ceramides support its protective barrier. Ask which texture suits your routine.

Ask our team about availability

Protect

Sunscreen SPF 50+

Daily sun protection is an important part of skincare, especially after treatment. We can help you choose an SPF 50+ sunscreen and explain when to reapply it.

Ask our team about availability

Renew

Retinoids & Night Care

Retinoids may help with texture and uneven tone, but they need a gradual introduction. Ask our medical team whether they suit you and how often to use them.

Ask our team about availability

Recover

Care After Treatment

After a peel, laser or microneedling session, your skin may need a simpler routine. We will explain which soothing products to use and when to restart your usual skincare.

Ask our team about availability

Even

Pigment & Brightening Care

Products for dark spots can be part of a wider treatment plan. We will explain how to use them alongside sun protection and any clinic treatments.

Ask our team about availability

Hair & Scalp

Hair Support

Hair and scalp care depends on the cause of the concern. Ask our team which home products, if any, could support your treatment plan.

Ask our team about availability

Message us on WhatsApp to check the current range, sizes and prices. At your next visit, bring a list of what you already use so we can help you put together a practical routine.
